title: Mouse
paragraphs: After flying for a while, it occurred to me that if I combined my bare feet with Magic, I might be able to absorb the impact. So I landed and searched the mansion on my bare feet, being careful not to make a sound. That’s when I heard the voices of the mammoths.

“Well then, the Shield Hero has arrived at the mansion of our Phant family. This is a perfect opportunity to demonstrate that our clan is indispensable to Siltvelt—but at the same time… Elmero, I must set the record straight regarding the misconception that you are our representative.”
“…The Shield Hero said he wished to visit this house through me, but…”

“Shut up. You should be grateful just to be allowed to sit at the very bottom of our clan’s hierarchy! You’re not even supposed to be allowed near the Shield Hero in the first place! And yet, you’re getting all high and mighty just because you captured a single brat and claimed it as a military feat!”
I wasn’t able to enter the room, but it seems Zou is here as well. Still, that’s quite an arrogant lecture.
I can hear Zou’s breath—it sounds almost like a sigh.
“Sunny, Fwan. You two must absolutely make a good impression on the Shield Hero! Your chances are during bath time and bedtime—you must not miss these opportunities!”

“As for the rest… have him watch tomorrow’s hunt, then protect the Shield Hero from the monsters you’ll secretly release there to win his favor! At that moment, Elmero! You must make it look like you were too incompetent to protect him!”
“That’s…”
Hmm… It takes some nerve to try to set a trap for Father. I feel like this alone is enough information to corner these guys, but this information will likely be passed on to Father by Zou beforehand.

“What’s this! Do you have a complaint or something! I was finally going to raise your rank from the lowest rung of the clan, and yet you’re turning down my goodwill like this—what do you think you’re doing!”
“...I didn’t mean to...”
“You’re a disgrace to the clan. Mother is so sad.”
“Ah, even though your older brother and sister have inherited such strong bloodlines… why are you like this?”
“Take a cue from your cousin, Rumes.”
Hmm, they really are an unpleasant bunch to listen to. This is definitely heading toward a ‘Destroy’ outcome.

“Ugh… The Shield Hero, is it…? I’ve heard he’s a lowly human, but since he’s a legendary hero, we absolutely must have his blood mixed into our lineage. That will certainly add prestige to our clan. The day we surpass the Four Representative Races is drawing near.”
“So, assuming we’ll have welcome music played tonight… what should we have our servant musicians play…?”
It certainly seems like the Mammoth Clan is a hotbed of conspiracy. Also, it looked like they were briefing Zou on their so-called strategy for what’s to come.

Eventually, the elephant wrapped up the meeting and, looking utterly exhausted, began making his way through the mansion. I thought he might be heading to the room where Father and the others—Kou and the rest—were waiting, but it seems not. His shuffling gait lacks any energy. He looks completely worn out.

Eventually… with a screech, Zou entered a dusty room that looked like a storage area. Then, he removed a floorboard at the back of the room… took out a box, and opened it. Out came a painting that looked like a large picture frame, and something that resembled a combination of a microphone and a megaphone. Also… a large handkerchief, perhaps?
Zou is smiling wistfully as he looks at these items. Shall we take a closer look? In the picture frame… what is it, exactly?

It’s a painting of Zou smiling with his hands pressed together, holding an elderly mouse-like Beastman. It looks like an oil painting, doesn’t it? I can imagine this is probably the same thing Kou was talking about. And the handkerchief Zou is holding looks like the cloak the elderly Beastman is wearing.
“Lady Rainy…”

Zou muttered under his breath, and though he seemed to be shedding a few tears… as the footsteps of other mammoths approached, he hurriedly packed the items back into the box, returned it to its original spot, and hid it away. After that, Zou retrieved cleaning supplies from the storage room… and it seemed he was being made to clean the mansion. Of course, this was deep in the recesses of the mansion, where Father and the others were unlikely to venture. Just then, a small shadow approached Zou as if sneaking up on him.
“Lord Elmero, Lord Elmero.”

Hiding behind an object as if sharing a secret, the voice’s owner spoke to Zou. Then, as if Zou had sensed where the other was, he glanced around as if wary of watchful eyes before approaching the spot where the shadow lurked and crouching down. There… a rat-like Beastman was hiding. The size difference is immense, isn’t it?
“It’s been a long time.”
“It has been a while, Meir. I wonder when we last met?”
“Of course, I believe it was the last time you left the mansion, Elmero-sama. Even now, the memory of that moment is seared into my mind and won’t fade.”
“…Are you still working in this house? Didn’t I tell you to leave right away…?”
“I, Mii, could not bring myself to leave this mansion, just in case Lord Elmero were to return at any moment.”

I see… quite an impressive little mouse. To continue serving for years on end, even without seeing one’s master… that is truly admirable loyalty. However, Zou is placing a hand on his head in a somewhat exasperated manner.
“While I, Meir, am overjoyed to see you again, I am also deeply angered by the arrogant attitude of the people in this house.”
The mouse beastman, looking quite displeased, takes a step forward and asserts himself to the elephant.

“All of us who served Lady Rainy—myself included—rejoiced as if it were our own achievement when Lord Elmero distinguished himself and was selected as the Shield Hero’s escort knight. Despite that, the people of this household do nothing but badmouth Lord Elmero behind his back… and to top it off, as you may have gathered, they’re even plotting to steal the position of the Shield Hero’s aide-de-camp!”

The rat beastman is explaining all sorts of things to Zou. Naturally, Father had already picked up on this. He’d often complained that whenever he participated in domestic events within Siltvelt, this sort of thing tended to happen. It seems Sakura-chan, Panda, Éclair, and Zou would step in to gently defuse the situation.
Well, apparently, on paper, Panda is the one holding that position? As for Sakura-chan… that’s out of the question!
“This is the very definition of shamelessness. I can only keep praying that divine retribution will fall upon those who seek to steal credit for Lord Elmero’s achievements…”

“You’re worrying too much. Besides, the Shield Hero is protected by Rasa, Eclair… Kou-san, and everyone else, so he’ll be fine. Sure, this is important too, but from my perspective, I’m worried about all of you—including you. Are you all right?”

The elephant gently places a hand near the mouse-beast’s ear, looking concerned. Then, the mouse-beast rubs up against that hand, using its body to let itself be stroked. That gesture looks familiar. It’s the friendly interaction that Kou and the other Filolial-sama use when dealing with the elephant. Did someone teach him that? Or is it perhaps the utmost act of consideration, born of concern over Zou’s own superhuman strength?
“…Neither harming nor sparing—the Phant family’s rule remains unchanged…”
Hearing the mouse beastman’s reply, Zou lets out a deep sigh.
“I send you money regularly, don’t I? You should leave this territory soon and move somewhere else. If you can’t escape, I’ll send someone to fetch you…”
“Oh, Lord Elmero… Your mercy is known to us all. That is precisely why we can endure it.”
Oh? Zou let out a visibly deep sigh.
“We’ll wait forever for you to be granted a fief and become a fine lord.”
Saying this, the rat-Beastman saluted.

“…It seems you have certain expectations of me, but once my duties as a bodyguard knight are over, I’ll go right back to being a knight of the open road, you know?　There’s no way I could ever become a lord…”
“But…”
“Anyway, leave this place quickly and find your own happiness. Nothing good comes from staying here…”

Just as she said that, a heavy thud echoed through the room. The elephant hurriedly resumed cleaning, as if rushing back to his post. He’s signaling to the rat beastman to leave with a wave of his hand. Seeing Zou’s attitude, the rat beastman reaches out, but his hand cuts through the air. Then the rat beastman turns the corner of the hallway at a brisk pace and heads deeper into the mansion.

Now then, Motoyasu, what’s the best way to gather information from here on out? It looks like Zou will keep cleaning for a while… It seems we’d be better off following the rat Beastman for now to gather more intel.

So, I’ll try to be as quiet as possible as I follow the rat Beastman. It seems he’s heading toward a low-ceilinged area that looks like a back entrance. From there, he exits through the back… and a little further away, there’s a somewhat run-down building that looks like a dormitory. From a quick glance, it appears there are the Rat Beastman’s companions… as well as human slaves marked with slave brands.
It looks like they’re all taking a break as they please. However, any voices that sound like conversation are quite faint. It seems they’re resting quietly to avoid making any noise.
“Meir, how did it go?”
A member of the same race as the rat Beastman calls out.
“I was able to meet Lord Elmero, but… he was his usual self. He didn’t live up to my expectations. He told us not to worry about him and to find our own happiness…”
The rat-beastmen have fallen silent.
“Still… it’s also true that we owe our current way of life to Lord Elmero…”
“Well… Lord Elmero treats us normally, but… as for us…”
The human slave joins the conversation, seeming troubled. It seems there are indeed various complicated circumstances at play.
“Since the Shield Hero is here anyway, shouldn’t we just go talk to her directly!?”
“But if you do something like that, your slave marks will activate. That’s not what Lady Elmero would want.”
“Ugh… what a hassle… Sigh… Even though that Lady Elmero has such a high status and immense power, she’s got more insecurities than anyone else.”
“Well, I guess that can’t be helped… Even among her own clan, Lady Elmero…”
Hmm… It feels like this is a good time to ask a few questions.
“Hey.”
“Hm? Didn’t I just hear a voice I don’t recognize?”
“I’m right here.”
I instantly cancel my concealment magic and the Cloaking Lance to reveal myself. The Love Hunter, Motoyasu, has arrived.
“Whoa!? What is that!?”
“You just appeared out of nowhere! Hey, didn’t you sense my presence or anything?”
The human slave confronts the rat Beastman. But the rat Beastman shakes his head with a look of surprise.
“I didn’t notice… Honestly, nothing at all. I think that’s some seriously impressive concealment skill.”
“W-who are you!?”
It seems he’s on his guard.
“Don’t you know?”
I twirl my spear around. Didn’t you see it when you entered the mansion in the first place? Ah, I suppose you didn’t see it because it was hidden. Maybe you’d be punished if you had seen it.
“Um, are you… the Spear Hero… perhaps?”
“That’s right. For certain reasons, at the orders of Father… the Shield Hero, I was gathering intelligence.”
“The Spear Hero who displayed strength like a demon god on that battlefield against Shieldfreeden and Melromarc’s disguised army?”
“Would someone that famous even come to a place like this?!”
“Wait—if he has the ability to remain hidden to this extent… it might actually be possible.”
The rat-like Beastman called Meir quickly snapped back to his senses and stopped those around him. It’s a relief that he’s so quick to understand.
“So, Spear Hero, under what circumstances have you graced us with your presence?”
“There’s a lot I’d like to ask…”

What should I ask first? From my perspective, I owe Zou a certain degree of gratitude for setting Kou straight. But when that made an impression on Father, it ended up sending me to Zou’s parents’ house. In other words, resolving whatever problem Zou is facing is my way of repaying the favor. From the looks of it, Zou’s so-called family seems to be hatching some ridiculous scheme. Well, there’s only one thing to do, then.
“I didn’t need to ask. Since you all seem to care so much about Zou, you’re hoping I’ll destroy this household full of arrogant, ridiculous fools, aren’t you?”
It seems they’re plotting a treacherous scheme against Father. They deserve to die a thousand deaths.
“It’s time to slaughter every mammoth in this mansion. Hahahaha!”
“Who the hell is this guy!?”
“Oh shit!”
“Wait, please!　Spear Hero, please calm down!”
The rat-beastmen are clinging to me. What’s this about? If I wipe them out, the elephants should be happy, too.
“It’s true they’re infuriating creatures, but it’s also a fact that their presence maintains peace in the domain. Lord Elmero understands that as well. Please, at least don’t take their lives…”

Hmm… It’s just a hunch, but I get the feeling that if I went hunting mammoths, not only would Father be angry, but Kou would probably get mad at me too. It’s highly doubtful that the mammoth clan and the Elephants are actually related by blood.

Come to think of it, the same goes for me and Filolial-sama and the others. Even though this rat-beastman isn’t related by blood, he seems to care deeply for Zou from the bottom of his heart. In other words, family isn’t about blood—it’s about bonds and feelings!
“I understand. For Zou’s sake—and for yours—I’ll let it slide this time.”
